title: Varenicline for alcohol use disorder: ClinicalTrials.gov posted results only
intro: Randomized trials of varenicline against placebo with a posted drinking outcome after at least 4 weeks of treatment, from query.cond=alcohol&query.intr=varenicline, filter AREA[HasResults]true (20 records, 2026-10-15). Inclusion, outcome rule and the general/comorbid classification (smokers as comorbid) were committed before any outcome data were read (aud-comorbidity-prereg-2-2026-10-15.md). Dropped on reading: NCT00695500 (3 weeks of treatment, outcome a 2.5-hour laboratory session), NCT00580645 (outcome a 2-hour laboratory session on day 8). NCT01011907 was classified general from its listing, but on reading it enrolled smokers seeking to quit; the pre-registration forbids moving trials, so it stays general here and the _alt tags move it to the smokers' group as a sensitivity analysis. Where a posted value could be read two ways, the reading that works against the pre-registered hypothesis is used here and the other is in varenicline_aud_readings.json.

studies.label: Multisite alcohol dependence trial (Litten 2013)
studies.outcome: Weekly Percentage of Heavy Drinking Days

studies.label: Alcohol dependence pilot, 40 participants
studies.outcome: Rate of Heavy Drinking Days Per Week
studies.measure: heavy drinking days per week, 12 wk
studies.note: posted as medians with 'standard deviations' of 0.18 and 0.31 heavy drinking days per week, which is implausibly tight; read as SEs here (g about -0.27). Read as SDs, g would be about -1.22 (varenicline_aud_readings.json)

studies.label: Alpha5 nicotinic receptor pilot, problem drinkers who smoke
studies.outcome: Average Number of Alcoholic Drinks Consumed
studies.note: completers only (17 per arm). Enrolled smokers seeking to quit, so by the pre-registration's own smoker rule it belongs with the smokers; kept general as listed, moved in the _alt sensitivity

studies.label: Varenicline x bupropion factorial trial
studies.outcome: Alcohol Consumption as Measured by Heavy Drinking Days (HDD)
studies.measure: change in heavy drinking days per 14 days, days 21-77
studies.note: 2 x 2 factorial; varenicline arms (with bupropion or its placebo) vs the others (bupropion alone, double placebo). The posted PEth blood marker points the same way

studies.label: Alcohol dependence in smokers
studies.outcome: Percentage of Heavy Drinking Days During the Last 8 Weeks of Treatment
studies.note: three outcomes share this title (log weeks 9-12, log weeks 13-16, and an 8-week least-squares mean); the last 4 weeks of treatment on the log scale used

studies.label: Actively drinking smokers
studies.outcome: Heavy Drinking Days at End of Treatment

studies.label: Heavy drinkers' smoking cessation, varenicline or placebo added to nicotine patch
studies.outcome: Change From Baseline in Self-Reported Heavy Drinking Days at 12 Weeks
studies.measure: heavy drinking days, past month at week 12
studies.note: titled 'change from baseline' without a definition; the values (5.02 and 5.58 against baselines of 8.28 and 10.36) are read as week-12 levels here. Read as reductions, the sign flips (varenicline_aud_readings.json)
